name: The Sumida River in Winter Snow (Fuyu Sumidagawa no yuk…
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “The Sumida River in Winter Snow (Fuyu Sumidagawa no yuki), from the series "Famous Places in Edo in the Four Seasons (Shiki Koto meisho)"” by Utagawa Hiroshige (1834/35), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 59064. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
